candidates.statement: Suspension or Withdrawal of ASCA Recognition One purpose of the ASCA Program is to increase FDA’s confidence in testing results and DOCs 616 provided in premarket submissions. FDA may identify issues, using a variety of means, that raise 617 concerns regarding an accreditation body’s ability to adequately fulfill its role in the ASCA 618 Program. Section 514(d) of the FD&C Act provides that FDA may suspend or withdraw an 619 accreditation body’s ASCA Recognition . Full suspension or withdrawal affects an accreditation body’s entire scope of ASCA Recognition. Partial suspension or withdrawal affects one or more 621 parts of an accreditation body’s scope of ASCA Recognition. Upon suspension or withdrawal, the 622 accreditation body should halt all ASCA activities for the relevant suspended or withdrawn 623 FDA-recognized consensus standards and test methods. 624
